1) High-level compliance: please confirm whether MedSym requires SOC 2 Type II evidence, and if you need additional attestations (HIPAA BAAs or GDPR data processing addenda).
2) Vendor questionnaire: would you like us to complete your standard questionnaire, or should we send a short STA/vendor intake link? (I can send either).

Next steps from our side: if you confirm the preferred questionnaire, we'll start the intake and pull the artifacts (pen test report, vulnerability policy, SOC 2 cover sheet). Attaching a short artifact index once we have sign-off.

Hi Chloe — appreciate the summary. A few clarifications: 

- SOC 2: we require SOC 2 Type II for production vendors. A recent report (within 12 months) is preferred; a SOC 2 bridge letter is OK for initial evaluation.
- HIPAA/GDPR: MedSym handles PHI and has GDPR requirements depending on data flows. Please include any HIPAA BAA terms you can; we'll review.
- Pen test: yes — we need the latest third-party penetration test report (redacted if necessary) and a short write-up of your vulnerability lifecycle: detection cadence, patch windows/SLA, prioritization criteria, and disclosure process.

Also: do you have a standard vendor security questionnaire link? If you can send a pre-filled copy or an intake link, our team will start review faster.

We can do a technical review next Tue or Wed morning (PST). Who from your side should attend?

Thanks,
Andrew Lewis
Director, IT Security | MedSym Health

- redwood-pen-report-Q1-2027.pdf (redacted third-party pen test report, Q1 2027)
- vulnerability-management-policy.md (policy summary: detection cadence, triage, SLAs)

Quick answers: 
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering Security and Availability (period ending 2027-03-31). We can provide the cover letter and auditor contact under NDA.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We offer a BAA; GDPR DPIA / DPA language is available in our vendor terms. We'll provide the draft BAA template.
- Pen test: latest third-party assessment completed Q1 2027. Critical findings are handled via our vuln SLA: initial ack within 24 hours, patch/mitigation plan within 7 calendar days for critical findings, follow-up verification within 14 days. Regular external scans run weekly; internal scans run nightly.
- Disclosure: we provide redacted reports for vendor review and full reports under NDA to customers with business need. We also maintain a coordinated disclosure channel and will notify impacted customers within our SLA window after verification.

Next steps: Chloe, please share MedSym's vendor questionnaire if they'd like us to pre-fill (Andrew, sending the intake link should jumpstart this). Andrew — available slots for a 30-minute tech walk-through: Tue 06/22 09:00–11:00 PST or Wed 06/23 09:00–10:30 PST. Confirm what works and whether we should include our lead engineer (Karthik) for the technical deep dive.
